text:
rachel: heads up, i'm starting a refactor to split the current cluster-deploy role into two narrower roles so we can enforce least-privilege for CI and prod deploys. goal: remove direct secret/node patch rights from the regular deploy path and gate those to a tiny kms-unseal flow.

vik: nice. can you list the verbs/resources you plan to remove? also we need to confirm KMS audit events are being exported — want to be able to trace decrypts back to a pod/sa. :eyes: 

rachel: current role grants create/update/patch/delete on deployments, pods, secrets, configmaps, nodes. proposal: cluster-deployer -> deployments, replicasets, pods/exec (no secrets, no node patch). infra-provisioner -> nodes/csrs/storageclasses/daemonsets (no secrets). secrets access moved to a dedicated kms-unseal SA that has only KMS decrypt/generateDataKey.

noah: small caveat: our Buildkite runners running on gpu nodes use a short-lived key to fetch container creds. if we remove secrets access the runner needs to call KMS envelope decrypt. i'd rather add a kms-unseal SA than let deployers keep secret:get.

rachel: agreed. example AWS IAM for kms-unseal (placeholder):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345"}]}
```

ops-jen: remember to include kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt for envelope encryption. also ensure CloudTrail is forwarding KMS events to our audit log pipeline.

vik: on k8s side we should tighten audit policy for secrets and annotate the audit events with pod/sa info. i'd also like a webhook that adds an annotation when a pod hits kms-unseal so we can correlate KMS decrypt logs with k8s audit entries.

rachel: i've drafted role yamls and a small mutating webhook that adds `x-kms-unseal: "true"` to pods that call the kms-unseal endpoint. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/452

sec-bot: vulnerability scan flagged redwood/base:1.2.3 (openssl CVE-2024-XXXX). if infra-provisioner can patch daemonsets, that SA could replace images. add OPA policy to deny daemonset patches by infra-provisioner. example Rego: 
```rego
package kubernetes.admission
deny[msg] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "DaemonSet"
  input.request.operation == "PATCH"
  msg = "daemonset patches not allowed by infra-provisioner SA"
}
```

noah: good call, also update our image-scanner to fail deploys that reference vulnerable base images. and add a rule in the admission controller to require image provenance for daemonsets.

rachel: rollout plan: 1) create kms-unseal SA with restrictive IAM; 2) create cluster-deployer + infra-provisioner roles and bind them to the right SAs; 3) update CI/Buildkite to use kms-unseal for secret decryption (no direct secret:get); 4) canary in dev cluster; 5) monitor audit logs + KMS decrypt metrics for anomalies.

vik: i'll own step 1/2, noah can take CI changes, rachel will run canary. ETA: EOD Friday for PRs. i'll open the infra PRs today.

ops-jen: notes: rotate deploy SA keys after the cutover and add an alert for KMS Decrypt failure spikes (>=10/min). also add a dashboard for decrypt count per SA. :rotating_light:

sec-sam: runbook addition: if KMS Decrypt errors spike, page oncall and consider reverting to the previous deploy flow while we investigate. audit-team should gather CloudTrail + k8s audit for the window.

rachel: sounds good. any objections? if none i'll merge tomorrow 09:00 PT and start canary.

vik: +1

noah: ++

ops-jen: :+1:

sec-sam: noted, will update runbook.
